name: Fancy Shape Diamond Tennis Bracelet
subtitle: 3.35 CTW · 14K Gold
summary: Alternating round and marquise diamonds bring a delicate, distinctive sparkle to this 14K gold tennis bracelet.
description:
Our Fancy Shape Diamond Tennis Bracelet combines the brilliance of round-cut diamonds with the graceful, elongated silhouette of marquise-cut diamonds. Alternating shapes create a delicate, distinctive sparkle that makes this piece effortlessly elegant.

Featuring approximately 3.35 carats total diamond weight, this bracelet is crafted with 32 diamonds, each carefully secured in a delicate prong setting to showcase its natural brilliance.

Designed for beauty and security, the bracelet features a box clasp with double side safety locks, fastening securely from both sides for added peace of mind.

Beautiful worn alone or layered with your favourite pieces, this bracelet transitions effortlessly from everyday elegance to special occasions.

An elegant twist on the traditional diamond tennis bracelet.
